did: Home's My data list now says what each kept recording is: how long it runs and its first words, about eighty characters, cut at a word, from the same hearing the note's own words come from. Home now plays any kind of recording it keeps back to your paired phone, not only Rust Rounds notes and Studio takes, and each row says whether it plays, so you can hear what you'd delete. The audio half went against the written privacy rule, so it was raised first, and your answer on some-ui#2473 is now cited in that rule.

calls.title: Which hearing a row's duration and words come from
options: The newest model's ending, as the spec literally said
The same choice the note's own words read makes: words over silence, then the newest
calls.why: So My data and the note's own words never disagree, and a later model that found only silence doesn't hide words an earlier one heard.
calls.undo: Change the subquery's ORDER BY in crates/db/voice/src/kept.rs, and the test that compares it with the note's own read.

calls.title: How the first words are cut
options: At the last space within eighty characters, or at eighty when there is no space
At exactly eighty characters every time
calls.why: A word cut in half reads worse than a shorter line, and Korean or one long word still gets a hard cut so the row stays short.
calls.undo: Change first_words and HEARD_CHARS in crates/db/voice/src/kept.rs.

calls.title: Ship the words and the playback as one pull request or two
calls.why: Your answer on playback arrived before the first half was pushed, and one pull request meant one review and one place in the merge queue.
calls.undo: Nothing to undo; both halves are in server#838.

left: The phone's side, the contract and the My data rows that use these fields, is the some-ui worker's, not this session's.

Playing a note now looks up each of the nine kinds in turn before it answers, nine quick lookups for a missing note where there were two; left as is, since each is a keyed read and it keeps one list deciding what plays.
